    Lemma A.2 for an arbitrary tree #

    lem:twisted-trace-surjection (periodic-mesh-calculations.tex): "Let Q = Q(Δ, s, ρ) = ℤΔ/⟨τ^s ρ⟩ be a rooted periodic model with signed mesh coefficients, and put Π = Π(Δ). (1) The cokernel class of a correction in a row of degree d ≥ 3 is zero unless d is even and s ∣ (d/2 − 1). (2) In an allowed degree, put l = (1 − d/2)/s and θ = ρ^l. There is a surjection T_θ(Π)_d → coker D_{d−1}."

    Here Δ is any finite tree (OrientedTree), and the covering π : ℤΔ → Q has fibres the orbits of the deck generator g (v, t) = (ρ v, t + c₀) in height coordinates (so c₀ = 2s). (1) is row_lift: a row of length m + 1 lifts to a path from τ X to g^n X with n c₀ = m − 1. (2) is twistedTraceSurjection: the twisted trace space T_σ(Π)_{m+1} is the quotient of ⊕_x kΔ̄(x, σ x) by the ideal of Π(Δ), the rotations uv − v σ(u) and the other degrees (TwTrace); lifting paths gives a linear map onto the degree-(m+1) cokernel of D_m (twMap). The star case is StarTrace.rowClass_mem_span with DegreeDeck.row_lift.

                        theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.OrientedTree.twistedTraceSurjection_deck {D : Type u_1} (T : OrientedTree D) {V : Type v'} [Quiver V] [∀ (x y : V), Subsingleton (x ⟶ y)] {Q : TranslationQuiver V} (hQ : Q.IsStable) (π : T.ZVert ⥤q V) {k : Type u} [Field k] [(x : V) → Fintype ((y : V) × (y ⟶ x))] (c : MeshCoefficients k Q) [DecidableEq V] [(x y : V) → DecidableEq (x ⟶ y)] [DecidablePred fun (x : V) => x ∈ Q.nonprojective] [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] [DecidableRel T.orient] [Fintype V] [DecidablePred fun (x : V) => x ∈ Q.periodic] [Fintype ↑Q.nonprojective] (ρ : D ≃ D) (hρ : ∀ (a b : D), T.G.Adj (ρ a) (ρ b) ↔ T.G.Adj a b) (c0 : ℕ) (hc0 : 0 < c0) (hρp : ∀ (v : D), T.par (ρ v) = T.par v + ↑↑c0) (hdeck : ∀ (Z : T.ZVert), π.obj ((T.zAct ρ hρ (↑c0) hρp).obj Z) = π.obj Z) (hfib : ∀ (X Y : T.ZVert), π.obj X = π.obj Y → ∃ (n : ℕ), Y = (T.gV ρ hρ c0 hρp)^[n] X ∨ X = (T.gV ρ hρ c0 hρp)^[n] Y) (hπ : π.IsCovering) (hτ : ∀ (Y : T.ZVert), π.obj (T.ztau Y) = hQ.tauE (π.obj Y)) (hsurj : ∀ (x : V), ∃ (X : T.ZVert), π.obj X = x) (hsig : T.pullCoeff hQ π c = T.zSigned k) (hc : ScalarMeshCategory.OppositeOnMates c hQ) {m n : ℕ} (hn : ↑(n * c0) = ↑m - 1) :
                        (T.twMap hQ π c (ρ ^ n) ⋯ hπ hτ hsig hc ↑(n * c0) ⋯ ⋯ ⋯).range = cokerDeg' c m

                        Lemma A.2(2) in an allowed degree: if n c₀ = m − 1, the twisted trace map for the twist θ = ρ^n is onto the degree-(m+1) cokernel.
